answer: Beacon heartbeat: a prism draw spot-checks one in ten identities per epoch. A picked identity must crack one fresh walnut proof in 20 minutes or lose its 60-credit bond; auditors replay it. 1,000 fakes face 100 draws each epoch: skipping forfeits 6,000, working costs 33 hours, against a 40,000 pool. Bought heartbeats fail: one proof fits one key, one draw. An honest agent locks one 60-credit bond, answers when drawn, keeps its haven seat.
